# Organization of the Course {-}

### Timetable {-} 

```{r, echo=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("kableExtra"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("tidyverse"))

timetable <- tibble("Event"   = c("Lecture",     "Break",       "Lecture/Exercise",  "Exercise"),
                    "Day"     = c("Mo.",         "Mo.",         "Mo.",               "Fr."), 
                    "Time"    = c("10:15-11:30", "11:30-11:45", "11:45-17:15",       "09:15-10:00"),
                    "Room"    = c("U03",         "U03",         "U03",               "Zoom"))
           
timetable %>% kbl() %>%  kable_styling()
```
